versions.changelog:
Initial release of Tristan RFQ Overseer — a skill for running an end-to-end Request for Quotation (RFQ) pipeline for procurement and sourcing operations.

- Supports RFQ intake from email or Telegram, storing all state in an Obsidian vault.
- Automates pricing calculation, supplier quote comparison (including cost-plus and advanced strategies), and draft response generation.
- Triggers on "T, we live?", inbound RFQ emails, Telegram "/rfq", "/price", "/strategy", and "/compare" commands.
- Drafted quotes are only sent after explicit user confirmation.
- Includes validation and guardrails to ensure process integrity and transparency.
